audit_items.proof_trace: Borrow enforces a strict pre-check `self.cash - self.cash_reserve.ceil() > amount` (reserve.move:197), which is more conservative than the `>=` the property requires; the redeem path enforces `pool.available >= redeem_amount` implicitly via `withdraw_underlying`'s post-decrement assert `self.cash >= self.cash_reserve.ceil()` (reserve.move:313), mathematically equivalent to a pre-check for `>=`. In Sui Move, u64 underflow aborts the transaction, so there is no silent bypass on either path.
